integrity: The all-parameter statement is proved symbolically from simultaneous realization, the Nielsen/twisted-conjugacy criterion, and the conjugacy invariance of cyclically reduced length in a free group. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The construction gives arbitrarily large finite sets of realized Nielsen classes with identical linking data, but does not prove those classes essential, does not determine the Nielsen number, and does not produce one homeomorphism with infinitely many distinct classes.
title: Unbounded collapse of linking data on realized Nielsen classes
